_note: DRAFT — hand-authored ALSA control map for the Clarett 2Pre (Thunderbolt), paired with fcp-devmap-clarett-2pre.json. This is the PRESENTATION layer: it names the ALSA controls and gives their types/ranges/enum labels; the offsets and per-channel bindings live in the devmap. fcp-server creates a control for each entry whose key resolves to a devmap APP_SPACE member (via device-specification for input/output controls). Scoped to a confident 2Pre slice (preamp air/mode, monitor/output levels, master mute/dim); see _todo for what is deferred.
_provenance: Control names/types match the snd-clarett in-kernel control set (scarlett2 parity) for the 2Pre. Clean-room: authored from our own control set + the shipped fcp-alsa-map-821d.json schema, not any vendor map.
